memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Have them take a young bull with its grain offering of the finest flour mixed with olive oil; then you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering. Bring the Levites to the front of the tent of meeting and assemble the whole Israelite community. You are to bring the Levites before the Lord, and the Israelites are to lay their hands on them." - Num 8:8-10 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The cleansing of the Levites involved sacrifice — a sin offering to deal with sin, and a grain offering. And then, in a striking moment, the whole community laid their hands on the Levites, presenting them before the Lord. It was as if the people were saying, "These men stand for us; they serve God on our behalf."

The laying on of hands was a gesture of identification and dedication. The Levites were being set apart, given to God, offered up for His service in place of the people. There was a real sense of the whole community participating — the Levites did not serve alone, but as representatives of everyone.

This reminds us that serving God is never a purely private matter. Those who serve do so within the family of God's people, supported by them, standing in some sense for them. When someone gives themselves to God's work, the whole community shares in it.

The sacrifices remind us, once more, that all acceptable service to God rests on atonement. Even those being dedicated to serve needed a sin offering. Their fitness to serve came not from their own goodness but from sacrifice made on their behalf.

And this points to Jesus, who was offered up once for all, and who now presents us to God as those who belong to Him. In Him, we too are "offered" to God — living sacrifices, dedicated to His service (Rom 12:1).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you see serving God as connected to His whole family?
- How does it help to know your service rests on Christ's atonement, not your goodness?
- Have you offered yourself to God for His service?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that through Christ's sacrifice I can be offered to You for service. I give myself to You today as one who belongs wholly to You. Amen.
